channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound flat lines near 215.00 as looming intervention risks support JPY
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross attracts fresh sellers in the vicinity of mid-215.00s and slides to the lower end of its daily range during the early European session on Friday.

item.title: Japan’s Kihara: Closely monitoring market movements with high sense of urgency
item.description: Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara reiterates, during the European session on Friday, that the administration is closely monitoring FX moves and is ready to intervene when needed. Kihara also said on Tuesday that officials are always ready to take the necessary action on forex.

item.title: Dow Jones futures climb as cooling economic data lower Fed rate hike odds
item.description: The Dow Jones futures gain 0.24% to trade above 53,300, while S&P 500 futures rise 0.46%, trading near 7,560. Meanwhile, Nasdaq 100 futures advance 1.0% to trade near 29,850 during European trading hours on Friday.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecast: Euro languishes around 0.8565 with bears in control
item.description: The Euro (EUR) remains stalled right above one-year lows against the British Pound (GBP) on Friday.

item.title: British Pound: Overbought rally eyeing 1.3410 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: According to UOB’s Quek Ser Leang, GBP/USD’s strong six-day advance to 1.3385 looks overstretched, but there is still scope for a retest of 1.3385 in the near term, with support at 1.3325/1.3300.

item.title: Indian Rupee regains ground on lower oil prices, easing hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens slightly higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday. The USD/INR pair drops to near 95.26 due to broader underperformance in the US Dollar, following the release of the weak United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for June on Thursday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks and softer payrolls – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes that softer US non-farm payrolls and suspected FX intervention supported the Japanese Yen, pushing USD/JPY sharply lower. He highlights that weaker payrolls reduce the likelihood of a near-term Fed rate hike but do not clarify the broader labour and inflation outlook.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar under pressure as markets reassess Fed outlook
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Friday, July 3:

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises above $62.00 within broader bearish setup
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) jumps to the weekly high near $62.15 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The precious metal extends the rally as a weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls ‌(NFP) report has reduced expectations of Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hikes this year.

item.title: Gold holds near two-week top as USD stays weak amid fading Fed rate hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone near a one-and-a-half-week top, though it lacks follow-through and remains below the $4,200 mark heading into the European session on Friday.

item.title: Equities: Asia tech rebound and Europe records – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid and team report a rebound in Asian equities, led by a sharp rise in the KOSPI and Samsung Electronics on AI chip news, alongside gains in Chinese and Australian indices.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Falls to near 100.50 despite prevailing bullish bias
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its losses for the second successive day, trading around 100.60 during the early European hours on Friday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Refreshes weekly high near 0.5725 as US Dollar weakens
item.description: The NZD/USD pair posts a fresh weekly high at around 0.5725 during the European trading session on Friday. The Kiwi pair reflects strength as risk-on market sentiment due to a slight cool down in hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations has improved the appeal of antipodeans.

item.title: Gold: Softer US data boosts safe-haven demand – ING
item.description: ING’s commodities strategists highlight that Gold rallied after weaker US jobs data reduced fears of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Lower Treasury yields and a softer Dollar improved the appeal of non-yielding assets.

item.title: Turkish Lira: Limited relief from June inflation – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects Turkey’s June Consumer Price Index (CPI) to show a modest disinflation surprise, with headline and core rates easing slightly and month-on-month inflation potentially below 1%.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecasts: Aussie approaches 0.6950 with bullish momentum building up
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) appreciates for the second consecutive day against a weaker US Dollar (USD) on Friday, still weighed by Thursday’s US Nonfarm Payrolls’ disappointment.

item.title: Euro: Upside bias capped by resistance against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang highlights that EUR/USD failed to extend gains after spiking to 1.1472 and is now expected to consolidate between 1.1410 and 1.1455 intraday.

item.title: Japanese Yen steadies as intervention risks rise, Fed hike bets ease
item.description: USD/JPY holds its position after experiencing volatility, trading around 161.10 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair may depreciate as the Japanese Yen (JPY) could strengthen on rising speculation that Japanese officials are preparing another round of currency intervention.

item.title: WTI holds gains above $69.00 on a weaker US Dollar
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $69.10 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The WTI price recovers some lost ground on a weaker US Dollar (USD) ahead of a long holiday weekend in the United States (US).

item.title: Asian stock markets rebound on weak US data, lower oil prices, KOSPI surges almost 6%
item.description: Asian stock markets reflect strong demand on Friday, as traders reconsidering hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) bets and lower oil prices due to easing geopolitical woes have lifted demand for risk-sensitive assets.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests immediate barrier at VWAP of 185.50
item.description: EUR/JPY rises after two days of losses, trading around 184.50 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar looks to extend recovery from YTD low on weaker USD, uptick in Oil prices
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest bounce from a nearly two-week low and turns lower for the second straight day following a modest Asian session uptick to the 1.4200 neighborhood.

item.title: India's HSBC Composite PMI misses estimates in June: What 57.1 means for the Indian Rupee
item.description: The final reading of India's HSBC Composite Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) was revised down to 57.1 in June from the previous reading of 57.4, the latest data published by S&P Global and HSBC Bank showed on Friday. This figure came in worse than the estimates of 57.4.

item.title: Swiss Franc rises as US Dollar declines on easing Fed rate hike bets
item.description: USD/CHF extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.8020 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) loses ground amid a disappointing set of domestic labor data released on Thursday, easing bets on a Fed rate hikes.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Gathers strength above 1.3350, but stays capped below 100-day average
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3360 during the early European session on Friday. The British Pound (GBP) gathers strength against the US Dollar (USD) on a weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Trades cautiously higher near mid-1.1400s amid mixed setup
item.description: The EUR/USD pair attracts some dip-buyers during the Asian session on Friday, stalling the previous day's modest pullback from the 1.1470-1.1475 region, or a nearly two-week high.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Holds gains near 112.00, but bearish bias persists below key moving averages
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 111.75 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) following the Chinese economic data.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines as May's trade deficit suggests economic concerns
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 18,000 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds its position despite a disappointing set of domestic labor data released on Thursday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index faces pressure as traders reconsider hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, is marginally down to near 100.80 during the Asian trading session on Friday.
